fields.description: Master switch for the Customer Gold flow. When off, Customer Gold configuration may be left incomplete and no Customer Gold validation is applied.
fields.label: Enable Customer Gold Flow

fields.description: The only item accepted on a Customer Gold receipt. Must be an enabled, batch-controlled stock item.
fields.label: Customer 24KT Item

fields.description: Additional purities a customer may hand over, for example 99.5 alongside 99.9. Leave empty to accept only the Customer 24KT Item. Each item is booked at the Customer 24KT Item's rate scaled by its Metal Purity.
fields.label: Additional Customer Gold Items

fields.description: Stock Entry Type that represents a Customer Gold receipt. Its purpose must be Material Receipt.
fields.label: Customer Goods Stock Entry Type
Customer Gold Return Stock Entry Type
fields.description: Material Issue type used when unused customer gold is physically returned. The return posts at the metal's BOOKED carrying rate, never a current market rate.
Value of Particulars on the Gold Rates branchs row to read, for example Jain Jewels.
fields.label: Gold Rate Source

fields.description: Column on Gold Rates branchs holding the rate.
fields.label: Gold Rate Field

fields.description: Unit stored in Gold Rates. Per 10 Gram will later be converted to a per-gram rate before customer gold valuation.
fields.label: Gold Rate Unit

fields.description: Accounts are company specific. Add one row per company that receives customer gold.
fields.label: Accounting

fields.description: How a Customer Gold receipt values stock. Zero Value (the default, and the behaviour of every existing site) books the metal at 0 and posts no GL — the resolved rate is kept as evidence only. Nominal books the frozen per-gram rate as stock value with an equal Customer Gold Liability. Nominal changes an accounting policy and must not be enabled on a site holding real data without the recorded authority.
fields.label: Valuation Policy
